spaServiceNodeURL.description: The URL of the SPA service node to be used by the extension.

gatewayURL.description: The base URL of the gateway service used by the extension for send observability.

customerID.description: Unique CustomerID associated with the SPA deployment.

mode.description: Specifies the deployment type. Use 1 for SPA Cloud or 2 for SPA Hybrid.

sessionActivityInterval.description: Specifies the custom time interval (in minutes) at which the periodic sessionActivity event should be sent. The interval must be between 5 and 30 minutes.

sessionInfoRefreshInterval.description: Specifies the custom time interval (in minutes) at which the sessionInfo will be refreshed periodically. The interval must be between 5 and 30 minutes.

deploymentType.description: Specifies the deployment type. Allowed values are 'PRODUCTION', 'STAGING' & 'UNKNOWN'.

environmentType.description: Specifies the environment type. Allowed values are 'COMMERCIAL', 'GOV', 'JAPAN' & 'UNKNOWN'.

isCustomDomain.description: Indicates whether the deployment uses a vanity domain.

SpaServiceSigningCerts.description: Array of signing and root certificates for SPA service JWT validation. Each object contains key-value pairs where keys are KIDs and values are PEM-encoded certificates.
